verdict.rationale: Dropbox ships native e-signature capability via Dropbox Sign (formerly HelloSign), first-party integrated into the core product ('sign documents—without leaving Dropbox', 'Edit PDFs and get signatures' on plans page, 'Automatically save signed documents to your preferred storage account') plus a documented developer API (sign.dropbox.com, hellosign.com/api, signatureRequestSend endpoint) for embedding e-signature workflows. This is a genuine native/first-party solution rather than a third-party bolt-on. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the signing UX quality and enterprise-scale adoption evidence beyond marketing pages.
